description: This file defines the InvadersDashlet class, which extends the Dashlet class for the SuiteCRM platform. It implements a customizable dashboard widget with display, scripting, and configuration functionalities, specific to an Invaders-themed dashlet component.

classes.name: InvadersDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget class for the SuiteCRM platform, providing display, scripting, options, and save functionalities for the Invaders-themed dashlet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for InvadersDashlet, initializes properties, loads language strings, sets title and height options.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders and returns the HTML content for the dashlet, including its template.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Generates and returns the JavaScript required for the dashlet's scripting functionality.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Renders the configuration form for the dashlet, allowing customization.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Processes and saves configuration options submitted by the user.

methods.name: saveText
methods.description: Method intended to save user-entered text via AJAX, updating the savedText option.
